The band

Yorkshire's Country & Americana Band

Based in Leeds, Yorkshire, Tennessee Whiskey are a live country and Americana band with decades of experience playing across England. From the Cavern Club to student unions, we've entertained crowds at some of the UK's most iconic venues — and brought a taste of Nashville to every corner of the country.

Playing country music, Americana and rock, our inspirations include modern Nashville country artists like Chris Stapleton and Zach Bryan, legends of country such as Johnny Cash and Willie Nelson, as well as American icons like Bruce Springsteen and Tom Petty.

Country and Americana music should be about celebration, clapping hands, stomping feet and singing along at the top of your lungs — and that's exactly what we aim to do.

Available to book for weddings, birthdays, corporate events, festivals and more — across Leeds, Yorkshire and throughout England.
